summary.text: Jesse Parris is the Unity Party candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An activist who says he was born and raised in Northeast Denver, he also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Parris said he is a third-generation Coloradan who attended Denver Public Schools and graduated from Metropolitan State University of Denver in 2012 with a bachelor's degree in criminal justice and criminology and a minor in African-American Studies.
He said he became unhoused for a number of years after graduating and from 2013 to 2020 worked with homeless advocacy groups including Occupy Denver.
Parris was a candidate in the November 2024 general election for District 8, which incumbent Lindsay Gilchrist won.
